'''Steve Thompson''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 Decipher World Championship]] in November 2001 with [[Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor Ops / Build DS2]], according to Chris Gogolen's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3128">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-11-30-freedom-con-day-1-2d3128/ freedom-con-day-1-2], DeckTech (Chris "CGogolen" Gogolen, 30 November 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-11-30-freedom-con-day-1-2d3128/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
